chain_words.nuance: noticeably big, but not especially impressive in scale
above the usual size, the general neutral term
much bigger than usual, striking to the eye
extending over a very wide area or range
so enormous that it seems almost beyond measure

explanation: These words all describe great size, rising from a noticeable size to a scale that seems almost beyond measure. The shift is one of degree along a single dimension.

usage_notes.difference: 'Huge' describes an object or quantity that is very large in its own right, while 'vast' emphasises extent over a wide area or range.
